Variation: a plump round TADPOLE ball body (bigger than the legs suggest), two tiny stub front legs under the chin held a little forward, two short chunky hind legs, the coiled spiral tail with a wide pale-aqua fin edge all round. The FACE must look FIERCE and DETERMINED, ready to fight: big round eyes OPEN (not half closed), the heavy lid of each eye slanting DOWN toward the snout like an angry V-shaped brow and covering only the top quarter of the iris, the pupil a short thick horizontal bar in the middle of the iris; the mouth open showing the deep-rose inside and the pink tongue. Never sleepy, never bored, never grumpy-tired. Save as L1_concept_3.png (the next free name).
